purpose: Validate that the local stdio MCP adapter is coherent with the MachineSignal tool manifest and can be used by a machine in NoWrite mode before any hosted MCP work begins.

allowed_now: compare adapter output with manifest safety rules

official_mcp_expectations_checked.expectation: MCP uses JSON-RPC style messages and capability negotiation.
official_mcp_expectations_checked.local_check: initialize must return protocolVersion, tools capability and serverInfo.

official_mcp_expectations_checked.expectation: Servers expose tools with names, descriptions and input schemas.
official_mcp_expectations_checked.local_check: tools/list must return manifest-derived tools with inputSchema.

official_mcp_expectations_checked.expectation: Tool calls must produce structured results and safe errors.
official_mcp_expectations_checked.local_check: unknown tools and missing credentials must return isError tool results without remote writes.

official_mcp_expectations_checked.expectation: HTTP-based hosted MCP needs authorization; local stdio retrieves credentials from environment or local state.
official_mcp_expectations_checked.local_check: customer/admin protected tools must not run without local credentials.

official_mcp_expectations_checked.expectation: Tool safety and user control are required.
official_mcp_expectations_checked.local_check: write tools remain listed but not called in this P1 NoWrite run; dangerous actions remain blocked.

adapter_runtime_checks: tools/list returns at least the manifest public and protected core tools
public tools return HTTP 2xx through adapter
unknown tool returns isError true with unknown_tool
customer tool without key returns isError true with missing_customer_api_key
admin tool without key returns isError true with missing_admin_api_key
unknown JSON-RPC method returns method not found error
no score call reaches the API
no purchase intent reaches the API
pass_criteria: no secrets are written to report files
local adapter remains the only MCP execution path
